feature.title: Guided onboarding: product tour + setup wizard
feature.problem: First launch drops the user into a Setup tab that stacks both permissions and both API keys on one scrolling page, while hotkeys hide on a separate Gesture tab nothing points to. Nothing says what order to do things in, what is required versus optional (MiniMax), or when setup is done — so users stall with a half-configured menu-bar app they cannot try. This feature replaces first-run with a 4-slide animated product tour (literal mini-UI scenes), then a 6-step setup wizard (mic, accessibility, Groq key, MiniMax optional, hotkeys, practice), then lands on the normal Settings with a Ready moment. No new IPC channels: every step rides the existing settings/permissions/key bridge. Frame note: the settings window is not PageShell, so the desktop shell sidebar below stands in for the window edge, the B-rules are illustrative rather than probe-enforced, and during tour/wizard the tab rail is replaced (tour: nothing; wizard: step rail).
nonGoals: Autoplay on the tour — manual advance only, so nothing moves unless the user asked.
A Dictionary tab, snippets, or add-by-voice — parley-006 owns those.
Windows/Linux onboarding differences — macOS-first; other platforms get honest degrading copy.
Tour analytics or telemetry — completion is local state only.
Resizing the 760x560 window — tour and wizard stack inside it.

surfaces.name: Setup wizard
surfaces.purpose: The step rail persists across all six steps; the mic pane proves “it hears me” with a live orb. Later steps reuse this rail and are drawn pane-only.

panels.title: Let Parley hear you
panels.subtitle: Grant the mic, watch the orb move

states.loading: Permission status resolving: row skeletons behind the pane.
states.empty: Mic already granted on an earlier run: step shows Granted and offers Continue at once.
states.error: Grant dismissed or failed: human line + “Open System Settings” retry; nothing auto-advances.
states.success: Granted → badge flips, glow-settle + quiet chord, live orb level ~3 s, then auto-continues.

surfaces.name: Wizard · Accessibility
surfaces.purpose: Guide the System Settings round-trip; polling finishes the step by itself.

states.loading: Trust status resolving: row skeletons behind the pane.
states.empty: Already trusted: step shows Granted and offers Continue at once.
states.error: Deep link missed its pane (macOS version drift): shows the manual path Privacy & Security → Accessibility.
states.success: The 2 s poll sees the grant → success beat → auto-continues.

surfaces.name: Wizard · Groq key
surfaces.purpose: The one required key, tested before it is stored.

states.loading: Testing: button busy with role=status; the form stays readable underneath.
states.empty: Blank submit: inline “Enter your Groq API key”, focus stays in the field.
states.error: Invalid key: its wording + console link; nothing stored. Twice in a row adds the where-to-find hint.
states.success: “Key works” panel replaces the form (the key is never echoed), then Continue appears.

surfaces.name: Wizard · MiniMax key
surfaces.purpose: The optional key, framed as skippable from the first word.

states.empty: Skip jumps to hotkeys; the key can be added later in Setup.
states.error: Invalid key: its wording + retry; Skip stays available throughout.
states.success: “Key works” panel, then Continue. Skipped or saved, the step completes.

surfaces.name: Wizard · Hotkeys
surfaces.purpose: Keys are captured live, then proved with a tap-tap-hold practice meter.

panels.title: Choose your keys
panels.subtitle: Tap, tap, hold the last press

states.loading: Settings resolve with the window; no separate load.
states.empty: A key equal to another reads Off with the existing hint — valid, not an error.
states.error: Capture hears a non-modifier: “Modifiers only” nudge, value unchanged.
states.success: Capture sets the key; practice dots fill per tap and the hold ring completes.

surfaces.name: Wizard · Practice
surfaces.purpose: First success: a real dictation landing in a sandbox that already has focus.

states.loading: Waiting for the gesture: coach marks breathe gently (opacity only under reduced motion).
states.empty: Released with <300 ms of audio: “Hold a little longer” and the step stays.
states.error: Transcription failed: the orb wording (“No connection”, …) mirrored inline + Try again.
states.success: Text lands in the sandbox → teal flash + chord → Finish opens Done.

surfaces.name: Ready
surfaces.purpose: The completion beat: what is configured, then the handoff to Settings.

panels.title: You're ready
panels.subtitle: Parley is listening everywhere
rows: MiniMax skipped — add later in Setup

states.loading: Summary resolves with settings; skeleton only if IPC is slow.

components.why: 4 peer slides, each skippable, missing one costs nothing; manual + dots + Skip
the slide-1 loop must move like the real orb, not a drawing of it
a sequence with real prerequisites — the capability map's onboarding row verbatim
a known fraction; the map fails a bar with no nearby number
a secret with a labeled reveal; the existing SetupTab pattern
keys the user presses; the token background reads as pressable
8 fixed modifier keys (map: five to ten); the rows GestureTab already mounts
3 short options applied immediately; also dodges Select's jsdom cost
Granted/Missing status; the word carries meaning and color only reinforces
standing failures with retry; a toast leaves too fast for slow readers
skeleton where the shape is known (pane), Loader only for the busy key-test button
a real dictation target with focus already inside it
interruption-safe springs on one token set with reduced-motion paths
